career_profile.title: About Me
career_profile.summary:
**Passionate Full Stack Developer** with 6+ years of experience building scalable web applications and developer tools. I thrive at the intersection of **elegant code** and **exceptional user experience**.

Currently focused on **cloud-native architectures** and **developer experience optimization**. Active open source contributor with 50+ GitHub repositories and 2,000+ stars across my projects.

**Technical Philosophy:**
- Write code that humans can read
- Automate everything that can be automated
- Test early, test often, test meaningfully
- Documentation is a feature, not an afterthought

I believe in **continuous learning** and regularly share knowledge through blog posts, conference talks, and mentoring junior developers.
